members.name: defaultAccountName
members.doc: The default account name associated with the keychain items.

members.name: accountName
members.doc: `kSecAttrService`: **Shared**. Represents the service or application name associated with the item. Typically used to group related keychain items.

members.name: groupId
members.doc: `kSecAttrAccessGroup`: **Shared**. Specifies the app group for shared access. Allows multiple apps in the same app group to access the item.

members.name: accessibility
members.doc: `kSecAttrAccessible`: **Shared**. Defines the accessibility level of the keychain item. Controls when the item is accessible (e.g., when the device is unlocked or after first unlock).

members.name: synchronizable
members.doc: `kSecAttrSynchronizable`: **Shared**. Indicates whether the keychain item should be synchronized with iCloud. `true` enables synchronization, `false` disables it.

members.name: label
members.doc: `kSecAttrLabel`: **Unique**. A user-visible label for the keychain item. Helps identify the item in keychain management tools.

members.name: description
members.doc: `kSecAttrDescription`: **Shared or Unique**. A description of the keychain item. Can describe a category of items (shared) or be specific to a single item.

members.name: comment
members.doc: `kSecAttrComment`: **Shared or Unique**. A comment associated with the keychain item. Often used for metadata or debugging information.

members.name: isInvisible
members.doc: `kSecAttrIsInvisible`: **Shared or Unique**. Indicates whether the keychain item is hidden from user-visible lists. Can apply to all items in a category (shared) or specific items (unique).

members.name: isNegative
members.doc: `kSecAttrIsNegative`: **Unique**. Indicates whether the item is a placeholder or a negative entry. Typically unique to individual keychain items.

members.name: creationDate
members.doc: `kSecAttrCreationDate`: **Unique**. The creation date of the keychain item. Automatically set by the system when an item is created.

members.name: lastModifiedDate
members.doc: `kSecAttrModificationDate`: **Unique**. The last modification date of the keychain item. Automatically updated when an item is modified.

members.name: resultLimit
members.doc: `kSecMatchLimit`: **Action-Specific**. Specifies the maximum number of results to return in a query. For example, `1` for a single result, or `all` for all matching results.

members.name: shouldReturnPersistentReference
members.doc: `kSecReturnPersistentRef`: **Action-Specific**. Indicates whether to return a persistent reference to the keychain item. Used for persistent access across app sessions.

members.name: authenticationUIBehavior
members.doc: `kSecUseAuthenticationUI`: **Shared**. Controls how authentication UI is presented during secure operations. Determines whether authentication prompts are displayed to the user.

members.name: accessControlFlags
members.doc: Keychain access control flags define security conditions for accessing items. These flags can be combined to create custom security policies.

members.name: useSecureEnclave
members.doc: When true, opts into Secure Enclave–backed protection on iOS/macOS.

declarations.name: SecureStorageUpgradeReason
declarations.doc: Explains why storage is in the reported SecureStorageUpgradeState.

declarations.name: SecureStorageUpgradeStatus
declarations.doc: A read-only report from FlutterSecureStoragePlatform.checkUpgradeStatus on whether stored data survived a plugin upgrade. Producing it never writes, migrates, or deletes anything.

constructors.name: fromMap
constructors.doc: Builds a status from the map sent over the method channel. Unrecognised names decay to SecureStorageUpgradeState.unknown / SecureStorageUpgradeReason.none so a newer native side can't crash an older Dart side.

members.name: unsupported
members.doc: The status returned on platforms that do not implement the check.

members.name: state
members.doc: What, if anything, is wrong.

members.name: reason
members.doc: Why storage is in this state.

members.name: entryCount
members.doc: How many stored entries the report covers. For SecureStorageUpgradeState.legacyDataUnreadable, how many would be lost.

members.name: willDiscardOnNextAccess
members.doc: Whether the next read or write will delete the unreadable data. True when state is SecureStorageUpgradeState.legacyDataUnreadable and `resetOnError` is enabled (the default); when false the data stays on disk and the next access fails.

members.name: details
members.doc: A human-readable explanation for a log line, if the platform gave one. Not for end users.

members.name: hasDataLoss
members.doc: Whether data is or was lost, so the app should re-authenticate the user or re-fetch what it had cached.

declarations.name: StorageCipherAlgorithm
declarations.doc: Algorithm used to encrypt stored data.
